units.source_text: 北野的秋季舞蹈会将持续半个月。

en.t: Kitano's autumn dance performances would continue for half a month.

units.source_text: 在结束的前一天，佐田太吉郎一个人出门去了。

en.t: On the day before they ended, Sada Takichiro went out alone.

units.source_text: 茶馆送来的入场券当然不止一张，可是太吉郎不想邀任何人同去。

en.t: Of course, the teahouse had sent more than one admission ticket, but Takichiro did not want to invite anyone to go with him.

units.source_text: 连看完舞蹈回家途中，同几个伙伴到茶馆玩玩，他也感到麻烦。

en.t: Even stopping by a teahouse with a few companions on the way home after watching the dances felt troublesome to him.
